representation: Reports, prompts and adjudications are byte-exact. Source chains are losslessly gzipped with mtime zero. Packet snapshot hashes identify captured text, which may differ in line endings from Git blobs. Bounded audit summaries are explicit derivatives; raw execution payloads remain local.
historicalLimits: Historical HELD_OPEN_CLAIMS, NEEDS FIX and UNVERIFIED verdicts are preserved as admissible evidence, never retroactively converted into accepted coverage. Only finalRuns accept this candidate. Earlier void/structurally rejected runs and their observations are not included or used by this lineage.
independence: Initial reviewers received source-only packets, not other reviewers' reports. Same-reviewer confirmations contain only that reviewer's own report and the actual candidate delta. Initial snapshots differ, so this is not a controlled model comparison or model ranking.
hashScope: All evidence files below; excludes this provenance file and separately authored README.
